title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Sneak Peek into New Financial Reporting Enhancements (part 1)

chapters.title: Internal description field for report authors

features.name: Internal description field
features.description: A new field that allows report authors to add internal descriptions to financial reports. This description is separate from the regular description column which appears as a heading in the report.
features.status_evidence_quote: we have a few things coming up in the 2025 release
caveats: Internal description should not be used for content that will appear as a heading in the report

features.name: Edit introductory and closing paragraphs
features.description: A new menu action that allows users to add text above and below financial reports. This text is displayed when exporting to PDF or Excel, useful for noting report status or approvals.
features.status_evidence_quote: we have a few things coming up in the 2025 release

features.name: Negative amount format option
features.description: A new formatting option called negative amount format that allows displaying negative numbers using parenthesis notation instead of minus signs. This is common accounting practice and applies to both screen view and PDF exports.
features.status_evidence_quote: we have a few things coming up in the 2025 release
caveats: Formatting is available as an option on the request page that can be selected per export
